source = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    frame = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 5]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in frame), max(r for r, c in frame)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in frame), max(c for r, c in frame)
    mid_r, mid_c = (r0 + r1) // 2, (c0 + c1) // 2
    markers = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0]))
               if grid[r][c] not in (0, 5) and not (r0 < r < r1 and c0 < c < c1)]
    if all(r < r0 for r, c, color in markers):
        side = 'top'
    elif all(r > r1 for r, c, color in markers):
        side = 'bottom'
    elif all(c < c0 for r, c, color in markers):
        side = 'left'
    else:
        side = 'right'
    for r in range(r0 + 1, r1):
        for c in range(c0 + 1, c1):
            top, left = r <= mid_r, c <= mid_c
            if side in ('top', 'bottom'):
                ordered = sorted(markers, key=lambda item: item[1])
                near_side = top if side == 'top' else not top
                use_left_marker = left if near_side else not left
            else:
                ordered = sorted(markers, key=lambda item: item[0])
                near_side = left if side == 'left' else not left
                use_left_marker = top if near_side else not top
            out[r][c] = ordered[0][2] if use_left_marker else ordered[1][2]
    return out
'''
